newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's guerrillas release at least two hostages.
newsitem.headline: Peru's guerrillas release at least two hostages.

text.p: Peruvian guerrillas holding at least 200 hostages at the Japanese ambassador's home in Lima on Wednesday released at least two elderly men they had held in the residence, witnesses said.
Another two men left the building but it was not immediately clear if they were hostages or Red Cross workers.
The two hostages were released about 10 minutes before a deadline of 12:20 p.m. (1720 GMT) the rebels had set for President Alberto Fujimori to begin negotiating with them.
The rebels said that if Fujimori did not start negotiations, they would kill Peruvian Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela.
